Missions

Serving where the Lord’s heart sends us

We meet practical needs while walking alongside each person toward self-reliance and hope.

Our programmes

  • Support for people in need

    Food, clothing, financial and spiritual help for people going through hard times.

  • Training workshops

    Workshops, seminars, talks and awareness campaigns that help people become self-reliant.

  • Helping other charities

    Supporting other associations that carry social and humanitarian projects.

Our four areas of aid

Food

Food baskets, supermarket drives and shared meals: no one should face the day on an empty stomach.

Give

Clothing

Clean, warm clothes chosen with respect, especially as the Québec winter sets in.

Give

Education

School supplies, homework help and access to books, so every child can build a future.

Give

Material or financial

Practical help when a family, a widow or a student is going through a hard time.

Give

In the field

Food drives

At partner supermarkets we invite shoppers to share a few groceries. Everything is sorted and handed to families.

Street outreach

In the streets of several Canadian cities we go to meet people without a home, orphanages and students, with a hot meal, warm clothes and a word of hope.

Where we serve

Montréal and several cities across Canada. Projects abroad will be specified [to confirm]. To protect the people we serve, we never publish exact locations.
